jobs.title: Engineering Intern
jobs.descriptionText:
Form MattersWho are we?OUR MISSIONTo make the coach-athlete relationship the most powerful and scalable asset in fitness.OUR VISIONA world where every fitness coach — regardless of how many clients they have — coaches with the intelligence, insight, and precision of the best in the world.We are not building another fitness app.We are building the intelligence layer beneath every coaching relationship — making coaches more effective, athletes more seen, and businesses more resilient.What is this job about?We are looking to hire an engineering intern who will help us deliver features for our app. Form matters is a platform that celebrates coaches and aims to reduce the time and effort needed by the coaches to ensure that their athletes become the best version of themselves. We are a young startup, things move fast and you will be working very closely with the co-founders to build and ship features and solve challenges that come along the way. You will be working across design, frontend and backend. We are also an AI-first company, so AI is woven into our work from Day 1.Who are we looking for?We are looking for a person who demonstrates the following qualities:      High agency: you are self-driven and figure out what needs to be done rather than waiting to be told, ready to try and test fail fast and move forwardHigh integrity: You see problems through to a real solution instead of settling for half-measures. If something doesn’t feel right to you, you take steps to make it rightA bias towards delivery and security: “delivered” is better than “perfect”, but “shipped” never means “insecure”. You know where to draw the lineCuriosity: Must not be afraid of trying and learning new things on your ownStrong communicator: most of the team works asynchronously, so good communication skills are required. You should ask questions as much as possible and let the team know of blockers as soon as they appear rather than waiting for someone to come online and ask you if you have any blockersEmpathy: you’re happy to meet the team, client, partner m where they arePro AIWe work with NodeJS, Typescript, Express and Postgres as the main stack. We use AWS as the cloud provider and Docker as the containerization tool. 
What do we offer?      Compensation backed internship for 3/ 6 monthsMeaningful work: your work has a direct impact - 100s of coaches and athletes will use the features built by you.A fast-working environment where we ship features in hours - no bureaucracy and traditional office hierarchies to slow down work.AI first working culture. You will get your own Claude account giving you full access to frontier AI technology. Before beginning any work, we always think: how can we make AI do it faster for us?Opportunity to wear many hats: you will work across design, backend and frontend: we work as a cross-functional team, so there is no business team or engineering team or design team. We all work together where each one does what they are best at, maximising the team’s progress.Chance to grow with the company: statistics show that early employees have a big impact on how the company grows and usually reach higher positions faster.
Applying is simple — no resume, no cover letter. Just answer a few questions and show us something you've built.https://form-matters.co.in/applications/engineering-intern

jobs.title: Android Engineer Intern
jobs.descriptionText:
Branch OverviewBranch is a leading AI-powered lending fintech with 50M+ downloads across India and Africa. We use alternative data and machine learning to expand financial access for millions of people traditionally excluded from the formal financial system. Founded by the former CEO of Kiva.org and backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Visa, and the IFC, Branch combines mission-driven impact with world-class technology and scale.In India, Branch operates as a regulated digital lending institution and Middle Layer NBFC, building trusted and accessible financial products for millions of customers across the country. Our 250+ member India team is growing rapidly and works across technology, data science, risk, product, and operations to solve high-impact problems at scale.Certified as a Great Place to Work in 2025, Branch offers the opportunity to build meaningful careers while shaping the future of inclusive fintech in one of the world’s fastest-growing digital economies.About RoleAs an Android Intern, you will improve the Branch Android app by building new features, optimizing performance, and contributing to the overall technical direction of the app.You will work closely with other Android engineers, Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and Designers on various challenges and deliver a smooth and reliable user experience. You will actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and day-to-day collaboration with the team. You will take ownership of projects and features, driving them end-to-end from development to release. You will also suggest improvements, share ideas, and contribute to technical and architectural discussions.As a company, we are passionate about our customers, fearless in the face of barriers, and driven by data. As an engineering team, we value bottom-up innovation and decentralized decision-making: We believe the best ideas can come from anyone in the company, and we are working hard to create an environment where everyone feels empowered to propose solutions to the challenges we face. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a fast-moving, innovative, and customer-focused setting.Responsibilities      Building and improving features for the Branch Android app used by our customers. You will work on creating smooth, reliable, and user-friendly mobile experiences.Working closely with backend teams to integrate APIs and support new product features. You will help ensure the Android app works seamlessly with backend systems and services.Improving app performance, stability, and overall user experience. This includes fixing issues, reducing app crashes, and making the app faster and more reliable.Working closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other engineers to understand requirements and deliver features end to end. You will support the team in successfully delivering its goals and initiatives.Supporting integrations with third-party services such as payments, authentication systems, analytics, and marketing. You will help maintain and improve these integrations as the product grows.Participating in code reviews, technical discussions, and team collaboration activities. You will contribute ideas, learn from others, and help maintain good engineering practices within the team.Taking ownership of features and projects from development to release. You will be responsible for delivering quality work and ensuring a smooth rollout to users.Contributing to improving code quality, testing, and maintainability of the Android codebase. You will help the team build a strong and scalable mobile application over time.
Qualifications      Have some experience building native Android applications that are more than just toy projects. Applications with real users or an open-source project would be a great plus.You have a solid foundation in computer science fundamentals. Good understanding of Android development using Kotlin, along with modern Android development practices and frameworks.Strong understanding of modern Android UI development using Jetpack Compose. Comfortable building responsive and scalable UI components, managing UI state, and following modern Android architecture and design patterns.Experience building features that interact with REST APIs and backend services. Familiarity with third-party integrations such as authentication, analytics, payments, or messaging platforms is a plus.Have a deep understanding of Android app performance, crash debugging, and improving app stability and reliability.Curious about new technologies and interested in learning different parts of the technology stack beyond mobile development when needed.Demonstrated fluency with modern AI-assisted development workflows and a point of view on their effectiveness for various use cases.Clear, structured written and verbal communication, comfortable operating async effectively.
Benefits of Joining      Mission-driven, fast-paced and entrepreneurial environmentCompetitive stipend as compensationA collaborative and flat company cultureA job offer depending on your performance during the internship
Read our Engineering Blog to learn about our technology, culture, and engineering practices: https://crafted.branch.co/We’re looking for more than just qualifications -- if you’re unsure that you meet the criteria but identify with our vision of providing equal opportunity to everyone to access financial services, please do not hesitate to apply!Branch International is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The company does not and will not discriminate in employment on any basis prohibited by applicable law.
